node.statement: Linearity gives the exact decomposition tilde-Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-tilde-Delta_n(XY)=(tilde-Phi_n-Phi_n)(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)+[Phi_n(Delta_n X Delta_n Y)-Delta_n(XY)]+(Delta_n-tilde-Delta_n)(XY). Therefore the triangle inequality bounds its norm by the sum of the norms of these three displayed summands.
